text:
Maria: Quick idea — running a 3-day micro-PSA sprint to intercept 3 at-risk midmarket accounts (Brightlane, Greenloop, NovaPay). Goal: prevent downgrade by focusing on onboarding gaps + feature enablement. Volunteers for live concierge sessions? :wave:

Alex: I can do Brightlane. 30–45m call + targeted checklist.

Tom: I can own Greenloop. Do we have a short email we can send before the call to reduce churn risk?

Lina: Yes. Suggest sequence: 1) short email, 2) 30m concierge session, 3) 1-week follow-up + success checklist.

Priya: I’ll draft the email & checklist. Pushing a CRM task: tag = "micro-psa-sprint" and set urgency = high.

Maria: Here's a quick email template — feel free to tweak:

```
Subject: Quick enablement session to help you hit X
Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed a few setup items that would unlock [feature]. Can we hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk through? I'll bring a checklist and actionable next steps.
Best,
[CS rep]
```

Alex: Nice. For Brightlane I'll schedule Wed 10:30 PT. Adding notes in CRM.

Tom: Greenloop OK for Thu 2pm PT. Priya — please attach the checklist to the CRM task.

Priya: Done. Checklist link: https://redwood.internal/doc/psa-micro-checklist — added to both tasks, tag applied.

Maria: For NovaPay I'm short on bandwidth. Can someone take it if it's an urgent downgrade risk? :thinking:

Lina: I can take NovaPay Friday morning. Will run the checklist and capture feedback items into the 'onboarding-gaps' ticket.

Alex: Quick ask — if we find a config blocker, escalate to eng-oncall and include priority label "psa-blocker".

Priya: Noted. I'll add escalation steps to the CRM task template.

Maria: Awesome. Final ask — capture one line: what would make the customer stick? We'll use that for a short win-log. :memo:

Tom: I'll add: 'short-term production stability + docs walkthrough' to Greenloop notes.

Lina: NovaPay: 'missing API key rotation docs' — Logging.

Alex: Brightlane: 'lack of sample prompts for ops flow' — will deliver examples.

Maria: Thanks team :rocket: Let's sync Friday 4pm for a 15m retro and handoffs.
